log:
maria: alarm from telemetry — inter-region VPN between eu-west2 and us-west1 is flapping, seen ~30% packet loss on the backbone for last 3 mins. Dedicated pools in eu-west2 showing increased p99 latency and some TLS failures.
lia (oncall): seeing retries/502s on private deployments. autoscaler still up but KV replication lagging. spike in redis errors: "MOVED" timeouts.
sam: confirmed from BGP side — an ISP on the eu-west2 peering went noisy, route withdraws causing transient disconnects. net team already on it, filing with provider now.
kevin: traffic engineer says we can shift customer traffic off the affected VPN to the eu-central1 fallback via smart-routing. will need a quick policy change; risk is slight cost increase for cross-region egress.
maria: prioritize customers on Private/VPC + Dedicated first — they have SLAs. support-ops, can you assemble the list of affected orgs?
support-ops: pulling list, will DM. initial scope: ~12 Dedicated tenants, ~40 Private endpoints (EU). adding them to bridge now. :spiral_calendar:
incident-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0452 — Cross-region VPN instability (eu-west2 <-> us-west1). Severity: P2. Bridge: #incident-2067890123-bridge
emily-cs: pinging CS for heads-up to enterprise contacts. drafting message.
lia (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) set smart-routing to prefer eu-central1 for eu-west2 private routes 2) enable per-tenant egress fallback to Hosted endpoints for customers who opt-in 3) apply temporary rate-limits to avoid tail retries hitting autoscaler.
sam: network already provided an ETA of ~35-50 mins for upstream ISP fix. We should execute routing change in parallel.
kevin: executing routing policy change now. command:
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/v1/routing/policy/update \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"region":"eu-west2","preferred_fallback":"eu-central1","force":true}'
maria: applying cache invalidation after switch to avoid stale KV references. running invalidate on affected pools.
lia (oncall): starting rate-limit: 20rps per-tenant for affected Dedicated pools to keep latency acceptable.
support-ops: customer list DM sent to #incident-2067890123-bridge. tagging account managers for the big ones.
emily-cs: draft for status page — please review:
"We are experiencing degraded connectivity between eu-west2 and our US backbone which is impacting inference latency and request success for Dedicated and Private deployments in EU regions. We are routing affected traffic to eu-central1 as a temporary fallback. Engineers are working with the provider to restore the VPN. ETA: 45 minutes."
kevin: small tweak: add mitigation steps (fallback + rate limits) and clarify that Hosted API customers not impacted unless they use Private networking.
emily-cs: updated.
lia (oncall): rolling change completed. traffic now flowing via eu-central1 fallback. p99 latency for affected pools down ~40%, errors dropped to single digits. continuing to monitor.
maria: can we add temporary billing note for affected Dedicated tenants? CFO/finance needs to know about cross-region egress bump.
support-ops: noted — creating billing flag and tagging usage from the last 2 hours for review.
sam: upstream provider reports they've applied filters; BGP withdrawals reduced but still occasional flaps. they'll confirm stable for 10 mins before closing the ticket.\nkevin: suggestion: add a short-lived routing rule to prefer local peering when upstream stabilizes. will queue a canary rollback in 15 mins.
lia (oncall): monitoring dashboards look good. I'll keep the bridge open for another 30 mins.
emily-cs: status page published and customer emails queued for the affected enterprise accounts. copy pasted to thread:
"Status update: We've routed traffic for impacted Private/Dedicated deployments to eu-central1 to mitigate higher latency and request failures caused by an upstream VPN instability. Our engineering teams are working with the provider; estimated resolution is ~45 minutes. We will notify you once normal routing is restored."
support-ops: customer replies: one tenant asks for a manual IP allowlist change to point to fallback — support provided ip: 52.29.144.11 and instructions.
maria: thanks team. loooking for final confirm once upstream reports 10m stable. leaving oncall handover note.
lia (oncall): last_message: provider confirms stable for 12 mins. scheduling rollback to normal routing in 5 mins and will watch for any regressions. final ETA to close incident: 10 mins. :thumbsup:
kevin: rollback executed. routing restored to eu-west2 primary. no error spike observed.
lia (oncall): closing the bridge. incident summary will be posted to #postmortems with timeline and customer impact.
emily-cs: final status update sent to customers. copying summary to the incident doc.
maria: great work, short and smooth. log follow-ups: postmortem, billing evaluation, and check for auto-failover suppression tests.
